k7.rule: MFFU closes an account after 7 calendar days with no executed trade; the bot's keep-alive trades 1 micro when a clock gets short (switch on per account).
k7.christmas_squeeze: If an account's last trade is Mon Dec 21, its safe deadline is 2026-12-27 and the only session left is 2026-12-24 (Christmas Eve half day, halt 13:15 ET): the keep-alive must trade it, or trade any account that is quiet by Tue Dec 22.
k7.new_year: New Year: Thu Dec 31 is a full day, Fri Jan 1 closed. Last trade Mon Dec 28 -> safe by 2027-01-03 (3 sessions left): no squeeze.

atlas_payout.min_route: MFFU's first-payout minimum: profit $1,350 (buffer $1,100 + $250) -> ask $250 ($200 to you); $949 more profit needed
atlas_payout.goal_route: The plan's first payout goal: $1,000 at $2,100 profit ($800 lands); $1,699 more needed
atlas_payout.rules: 2 traded days a cycle, best day <= 50% of the cycle's profit, 48 h after the first funded trade; 5 sim payouts then live

taxes.rule: Move 30% of every payout into the tax pot the day it lands.
taxes.dec_vs_jan: A payout that LANDS in December is 2026 income (paid with the Jan 15, 2027 quarterly 1040-ES for Sep-Dec); one that lands in January is 2027 income (first 2027 quarterly due Apr 15, 2027). Same tax either way, only the year and the due date move. Eval fees paid in 2026 lower 2026's profit.
